description: Sets or removes your own profile photo (the picture in your Our Team header). Give an https image_url or a small image_base64; PNG, JPEG or WebP. Only your own record. Call without confirm first for a preview with the image size.

clear.description: Remove the current image instead of uploading (the page falls back to its default).

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

image_base64.description: Small image as base64 (about 180 KB at most); use image_url for anything larger.

image_url.description: https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (max 5 MB, 120-6000 px). Fetched by the server.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: team_avatar_set
title: Team: change my profile photo
